system.description:
Grant protection to an adjacent friendly unit. You move into that unit's square. The protected unit must be your size or smaller. While on top of that protected unit, it cannot be targeted by any hostile actions, including Area wide effects. 

This effect breaks when either you or the protected unit exit the same square.
Cleave into an opponent with a brutal weapon attack. Your attack gains +4 Atk and +2 Brk damage. Attacking with this weapon art prevents you from making Extra Attacks.
For when you have no choice but to fight unarmed.
Robust set of platemail that nearly covers the body in defensive plating.
A heavy iron hammer made for battle.
